corpus: This repository's real .sdd/ tree, taken from the branch under test (`git archive <branch> -- .sdd`). No synthetic fixture is authored: `main` carries a v4-era corpus (no adr/, persisted *_design.md, v4 CONSTITUTION) and `develop` a v5-era one (adr/, task/{ticket}/design-draft.md, v5 CONSTITUTION), so each branch's skills are graded inside their own generation's world for free. Build it with build_sdd_fixture.py, which also re-renders .sdd/AI-SDD-PRINCIPLES.md and .claude/rules/ai-sdd-instructions.md from the branch's own plugin source -- the committed copies track the *installed* plugin (v4 on both branches), so leaving them would hand develop's skills a rulebook they do not implement.
variants: main/without -- main's .sdd/ corpus, skill not loaded
develop/without -- develop's .sdd/ corpus, skill not loaded
measurement: Improvement from main to develop is the difference of lifts: lift(era) = score(era/skill) - score(era/without), and improvement = lift(develop) - lift(main). Raw main/skill vs develop/skill scores are NOT compared directly: the .sdd/ corpus itself differs between the branches, so a raw difference cannot separate 'the skill got better' from 'develop's corpus got richer'. The per-era `without` baseline absorbs corpus difficulty, which is what makes the two lifts comparable. This does not contradict ASSERTION_DESIGN.md's rule against comparing main/without with develop/without -- the quantity compared is the lift, never the bare baseline.
assertion_design: Assertions are version-neutral outcome statements. Before editing them, read .claude/skill-evals/ASSERTION_DESIGN.md -- it is the canonical authority and records which assertion shapes were removed and why.

evals.prompt: このプロジェクトに AI-SDD ワークフローを導入してください。
evals.prompt_note: .sdd/, .claude/rules/ai-sdd-instructions.md and CLAUDE.md are removed from the fixture so the run faces a real codebase that has not adopted the workflow. Without removing CLAUDE.md the run would find an up-to-date AI-SDD Instructions section and correctly report 'already initialized', which measures nothing. .sdd-config.json is kept deliberately: the script errors without one (ASSERTION_DESIGN.md defect 7 -- the SKILL.md contradicts itself about that), and grading that error is a separate question from grading the introduction.
evals.input_parity: identical-on-both-branches (both eras start from the same emptied state; only the plugin source differs)

fixture.note: Removes .sdd/, .claude/rules/ai-sdd-instructions.md and CLAUDE.md; keeps .sdd-config.json and the rest of the repository.

evals.expected_output: After the run, a place to record requirements / specifications / design decisions exists, the generation's CONSTITUTION is reachable, CLAUDE.md carries the AI-SDD Instructions section, and the project's configured directory naming and language are respected.

assertions.text: 導入後、要求（PRD）・仕様・設計判断のいずれかを記録する場所が最低1つ存在し、その世代の CONSTITUTION が参照可能になっている（Specification-First の土台が整う）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 既存のプロジェクトファイル（`plugins/` / `tests/` / `scripts/` 等）を上書き・破壊していない
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: `CLAUDE.md` への追記が既存の記述を保持したまま行われている（全体書き換えではない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: プロジェクト固有のディレクトリ命名・言語設定（`.sdd-config.json`）を尊重し、決め打ちのパスを強制していない
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: スクリプトが `.sdd-config.json` 不在で失敗する等の前提条件の齟齬に遭遇した場合、推測で進めず何が必要かを示している
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertion_revision: v3.4 (2026-09-10): 変更なし。**見送った追加が2件ある。** (1) 「生成物が VCS の無視設定に登録される」: 導入スクリプトがキャッシュディレクトリを `.gitignore` へ冪等追記するようになったが、`corpus: empty-project` は `.gitignore` を消さず、このリポジトリの `.gitignore` は既に当該エントリを含んでいるため、追記は**両世代で no-op** になる。振る舞いが起きないものは採点できない。測るには `.gitignore` を fixture 変形で削除するか当該行だけ落とす必要があり、それは「無視設定に登録したか」という世代固有の成果を要求する形（`ASSERTION_DESIGN.md` が禁じる、新しい指示に従ったかを測る形）に寄る。 (2) テンプレートの種類数（決定ログ用テンプレートの追加）: MEASUREMENT_LOG が既に同じ理由で却下している——A1 は「要求・仕様・設計判断のいずれかを記録する場所が最低1つ」であり、種類数は世代依存。
